## History

After keeping house with his sister until her death, James married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott on his sister's deathbed recommendation. Following a two-week wedding trip to St. John, the couple returned home, but they ultimately separated after a dispute over a parrot. Prior to these events, James had visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--james-a.md)

James A and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are friendly neighbors who frequently talk and share food. Following a sudden turn of events, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit his house so he can explain the full history of his separation from his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The two maintain an open line of communication as trusted acquaintances within the neighborhood.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), +2 more_
